messages:
maria: FYI — the onboarding sampleapp just surfaced a nasty dup-side-effect case. Users hitting our hosted create-order endpoint saw two orders when a 429 coincided with a token refresh + SDK retry. quick writeup and repro below.

kevin: Oof. any logs / repro steps?

maria: Steps: 1) sampleapp posts createOrder -> service responds 429 (rate limit). 2) token expires at same time, SDK triggers refresh. 3) original request retries after backoff but token refresh path also replays a queued request without dedupe. Result: two server-side creates. Happens for non-streaming write endpoints only.

josh: Can you paste the failing request snippet from the sampleapp?

maria: Here is the minimal client code we ship in the tutorial:

```js
// sampleapp/orders.js
await redwoodClient.createOrder(orderPayload)
```

maria: No idempotency key is set in the tutorial. Reproducer script below simulates 429 + forced token expiry.

kevin: So two problems in combination: (A) onboarding sampleapp lacks idempotency guidance for write ops, and (B) SDK auth-path allows unsafe replay during refresh.

lina: Agree. Our current token refresh uses a cheap optimistic path: any inflight requests that see expired token call refresh and then continue. We intended a singleflight lock but apparently some codepaths race.

maria: Proposal: 1) update tutorial to show using an idempotency header (x-redwood-idempotency-key) for write endpoints. 2) SDK: add a default-safe-mode for non-streaming write RPCs that automatically injects an idempotency key when none provided. 3) fix auth singleflight so refresh serializes requests that would replay side-effects.

kevin: I like the SDK default injection idea as opt-out. It would make onboarding safer without extra dev effort. But we need to be explicit about semantics (does server dedupe only if it sees header?).

maria: Server will dedupe on x-redwood-idempotency-key for 10 minutes. We'll document it. SDK injection would generate a v4 UUID per call by default. Devs can override by passing their own key.

josh: For immediate fix in sampleapp, we should change docs and the tutorial code block to: 

```js
import { v4 as uuid } from 'uuid'
await redwoodClient.createOrder(orderPayload, { headers: { 'x-redwood-idempotency-key': uuid() } })
```

maria: Also: small SDK change — classify 429 as retryable but only perform auto-retry for idempotent or idempotency-key-protected calls. Otherwise surface a clearer error and surface instructions to add the idempotency header in the error message.

lina: I'll open a PR to add a mutex (singleflight) around token refresh and ensure pending requests are paused until refresh completes. That should prevent the parallel replay path.

kevin: Tests: We need an e2e that simulates a 429 + auth refresh race and asserts single server-side side-effect. Add a unit test for the SDK's retry classifier to confirm it doesn't auto-retry unsafe writes without idempotency.

maria: I'll modify the sampleapp and tutorial docs. josh can you add the e2e harness to the ingestion testbed?

josh: Yep. I'll add a harness that injects a fake 429 on the first attempt and forces token expiry during the same window. Will assert server saw exactly 1 create.

kevin: API surface for SDK defaults: new client option `safeWriteMode: 'auto' | 'explicit' | 'off'` (default `'auto'`). In 'auto' SDK adds idempotency header for non-streaming write calls when not provided. Thoughts?

maria: sounds good. Add telemetry event when SDK injects a key so we can measure how many customers rely on automatic injection. 

lina: PR plan: auth-singleflight fix (low risk patch) -> unit tests -> let devex team try sampleapp locally -> patch SDK defaults + docs -> release patch.

replay-bot: note: created issue #4127 "sdk: unsafe replay during token refresh" assigned to lina.

kevin: Who will own the RFC/notes for this? I can draft a short RFC describing the default idempotency header injection and retry classifier change.

maria: Please do. Include migration notes for existing users and a short snippet for the tutorial. Target: patch release in next minor (x.y.1) and docs update asap.

deploy-bot: branch opened: fix/4127-auth-singleflight-sampleapp-idempotency by lina

maria: Thanks all. Short-term mitigation: update sampleapp tutorial, doc callout near write endpoints, and a quick note in onboarding email asking devs to set idempotency keys. Long-term: SDK default + auth fix + tests.

kevin: SGTM :thumbsup:

josh: I'll queue the e2e and ping when the harness is green.

lina: Starting the auth patch now, will link the PR in the issue.

maria: Closing loop — after patch merges we'll run the onboarding flow with the patched SDK and confirm no dupes.

kevin: ok, marking this blocker for the onboarding sampleapp.

maria: End.
